question: Do industry-specific age curves improve pooled continuous-age predictions?
scope: same 96 quarterly evaluation cohorts 2002-2025; no sampling
features: existing industry/gu/age_band plus shared continuous-age spline AND industry onehot times each spline basis
spline: degree2 include_bias=False extrapolation=constant fixed knots; no evaluation-fitted transforms
model: LR C1 max_iter2000 seed7; same global/industry/region shrink500 calibration
split: train Jan1 year-4, calibration Jan1 year-2
comparison: continuous_age_result versus interaction addition, raw-to-raw and calibrated-to-calibrated
limitations: Retrospective reused periods; fixed single candidate; no tuning or service update
regularization: Single pooled LR C1; shared and deviation coefficients L2-penalized, not a Bayesian hierarchical model
unknown_industry: zero industry-specific interaction; shared features retained
